result.topic_en: An Euler-product expression for the Dirichlet series of the coefficients of x^3 times the 18th power of the product (1-x^4)(1-x^8)(1-x^12)..., followed by a remark that analogous results presumably exist for several other eta-type products.

methods.what: Definition of coefficients a_n via the eta-product q^3 ∏(1-q^{4k})^{18}

Expression of the Dirichlet series of a_n as a difference of two Euler products with quadratic local factors over odd primes (Hecke-type decomposition of a non-eigenform as a combination of eigenforms)

items.english: 156 times the Dirichlet series of a_n equals the stated difference of two Euler products.

items.quote:

items.english: Presumably there are analogous results for the sum of a_n/n^s when the generating function of a_n is any of the four listed functions.
